violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed ROP tuna in package in 2 Dr prep. PIC stated Tuna is received in ROP package frozen and is moved to cooler unit to thaw.
violations.corrective_action: EHS discussed with PIC to cut open ROP package of tuna before defrosting.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the HANDSINK at main cookline and smoothie prep is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Please provide proof of repair to EHS.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. Employee stated they have certification but unable to provide during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. Please provide EHS with copy of Food Manager Certification for follow up.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw turkey burger patties observed stored over precooked protein items in 2 Dr prep across from cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Raw turkey burgers placed in pan and moved to bottom shelving.
